property_summary: After any successful call to initialize(_baseToken, ...), the pool's public baseToken getter always equals the _baseToken argument supplied, a rule the reference satisfies for every input but the mutant violates since baseToken stays address(0) for any nonzero _baseToken.

For every admissible input (_feeRate <= 5000, _baseToken != address(0)), a successful call to initialize must persist the supplied base token so that c.flashFeeToken() equals _baseToken; the mutant drops the baseToken assignment, leaving flashFeeToken() at address(0) and violating the rule.
After initialize stores the caller-supplied base token, c.baseToken() must equal the _baseToken argument for every input; the mutant always stores address(0), so any nonzero _baseToken breaks it.

After a successful initialize call (fee rate within the 5000 bps limit), the pool's baseToken must equal the caller-supplied _baseToken address; the mutant always stores address(0), so any nonzero _baseToken violates the rule.
